title: Dense architecture overview
purpose: Twenty services in four DOT clusters with twenty-four links, above the advisory reader budget. Clusters become stacked groups. Labelled, dashed, dotted, undirected and two-way links keep their meaning, and one unsupported graph attribute is reported instead of being applied.

inputs.dot:
digraph platform {
  rankdir=TB
  splines=ortho
  node [shape=box]
  subgraph cluster_edge {
    label="Edge"
    cdn [label="CDN"]
    waf [label="Web firewall"]
    gateway [label="API gateway"]
    admin [label="Admin console"]
  }
  subgraph cluster_services {
    label="Services"
    identity [label="Identity"]
    catalog [label="Catalog"]
    orders [label="Orders"]
    payments [label="Payments"]
    search [label="Search"]
    recs [label="Recommendations"]
    notify [label="Notifications"]
  }
  subgraph cluster_data {
    label="Data"
    users_db [label="Users DB", shape=cylinder]
    orders_db [label="Orders DB", shape=cylinder]
    search_index [label="Search index", shape=cylinder]
    cache [label="Cache", shape=cylinder]
    objects [label="Object storage", shape=cylinder]
  }
  subgraph cluster_platform {
    label="Platform"
    queue [label="Event queue"]
    scheduler [label="Scheduler"]
    logs [label="Log store"]
    metrics [label="Metrics"]
  }
  cdn -> waf -> gateway
  admin -> gateway
  gateway -> identity
  gateway -> catalog
  gateway -> orders
  gateway -> search
  identity -> users_db
  catalog -> cache
  catalog -> recs
  recs -> search_index
  search -> search_index
  orders -> orders_db
  orders -> objects [label="invoices"]
  orders -> payments [label="charge"]
  payments -> orders [label="result", style=dashed]
  orders -> queue [label="order placed", style=dashed]
  queue -> notify
  queue -> search [label="reindex", style=dotted]
  scheduler -> queue
  identity -> logs [dir=none]
  orders -> logs [dir=none]
  payments -> logs [dir=none]
  gateway -> metrics [dir=both]
}

supported: DOT clusters as stacked groups, in source order
node defaults with per-node shape overrides
edge chains, labels, dashed and dotted styles
simplified: clusters are drawn as stacked groups with their cards in source order; Graphviz rank placement inside a cluster is not reproduced
